# TransportDock

The presentation transport: what is on screen, where in the deck it is, and the controls that move it.

## Anatomy

A status line with the slide number set as a display figure, over a grid of labelled controls. It sticks to the top of its scroller, and becomes a bordered card from the tablet threshold up.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` *(required)* | `string` | — | The mono status line — "Presenting", "Standby". |
| `current` *(required)* | `string` | — | What is on screen now. Truncates rather than wrapping. |
| `position` *(required)* | `string \| number` | — | The slide number, set as a display figure. |
| `actions` *(required)* | `TransportAction[]` | — | — |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | Names the toolbar so it can be reached from the landmark list. |

## Variants

Per action: `default`, `primary` for the committing control, `stop` for the one that ends the presentation.

## States

Per action: default, disabled.

## Keyboard

| Key | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Moves through the controls in order. |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Activates. |

## ARIA

A named region containing a `toolbar`. Each control carries its own name, and its icon stays decorative.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.

## Recorded deviations

| What | Why |
| --- | --- |
| The translucent backdrop was dropped. | The reference tints the dock with `color-mix` and an 18px backdrop blur, which puts text over an unpredictable backdrop and cannot be contrast-checked. The dock takes the opaque base surface instead. |
| The control count is not fixed at five. | The reference hard-codes a five-column grid; the columns now fit whatever actions are passed. |
